items.question: Zero-shot aur few-shot me difference?
items.answer: Zero-shot me example nahi hota. Few-shot me selected examples model ko desired pattern/format samjhate hain.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: System/user/tool messages ko kaise design karoge?
items.answer: Trusted policies ko high-priority instructions me rakho; user content ko data treat karo; tool outputs ko untrusted external data ki tarah validate karo.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Prompt injection ko kaise handle karoge?
items.answer: Instruction/data boundary define karo, retrieved text ko non-authoritative mark karo, tool permissions narrow rakho, sensitive actions par approval gate lagao aur adversarial tests chalao.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Long context ka simple solution kya hai?
items.answer: Sab kuch dump karna nahi; retrieval, compression, summarization, recency/priority ranking aur task-specific context windows use karo.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Context budget kaise decide karoge?
items.answer: Har request ke liye input, retrieved evidence, tool results aur output ke liye budget define karunga; low-value history ko compress/drop karunga.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Prompt me business rules kahan rakhoge?
items.answer: Trusted business rules ko controlled system/policy layer me rakho; user-provided text ko authoritative instruction nahi maanunga.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Structured output sirf JSON hona enough hai?
items.answer: Nahi. Schema validation, type constraints, allowed enums, business-rule validation aur side-effect checks bhi chahiye.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Prompt regression kaise test karoge?
items.answer: Versioned eval set par old vs new prompt run karke correctness, safety, tool selection, latency aur cost compare karunga.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: Tool result bahut bada ho to?
items.answer: Relevant fields extract, summarize or paginate karo; raw giant payload ko directly model context me mat dump karo.
items.heading: Advanced prompt interview topics

items.question: 2026-07-28 MCP release ka big architectural change kya hai?
items.answer: Protocol core stateless banaya gaya; requests self-describing ho sakte hain, aur normal load balancer ke peeche instances route kiye ja sakte hain.
items.heading: Important primitives

items.question: MCP tool ko secure kaise rakhoge?
items.answer: Narrow schema, least privilege, explicit authorization, output validation, audit logs, rate limits, user approval for sensitive actions, aur untrusted server content ko trusted instructions na maana.
items.heading: Important primitives

items.question: Dashboard me 20 KPIs dikhana sahi hai?
items.answer: Usually nahi. User role aur decision ke hisaab se top KPIs, drill-down, filters aur alerts design karo. Dashboard ka purpose decision enable karna hai, data dump karna nahi.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: Correlation high ho to causation prove hota hai?
items.answer: Nahi. Confounding, reverse causality aur selection bias possible hain. Causal claim ke liye experiment ya stronger identification strategy chahiye.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: Class imbalance me accuracy misleading kyun ho sakti hai?
items.answer: Agar positive class rare hai to all-negative prediction bhi high accuracy de sakta hai. Precision, recall, PR-AUC aur business cost matrix zyada informative ho sakte hain.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: Model probability calibrated kyun hona chahiye?
items.answer: Agar 0.8 score ka matlab repeatedly 80% event likelihood nahi hai, to thresholding aur risk decisions unreliable ho sakte hain. Calibration curves/Brier-style checks useful hain.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: Train-test split me group leakage kya hai?
items.answer: Same customer/device/document ke related rows train aur test dono me chale gaye to score unrealistically high ho sakta hai. Group-aware split use karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: Experiment me primary aur guardrail metric kya?
items.answer: Primary metric main success criterion hai; guardrail metric harmful side-effects jaise latency, churn, refunds ya error rate detect karta hai.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: Feature distribution production me badal jaye to?
items.answer: Drift monitor karo, root cause dekho, threshold/model retrain ya feature pipeline fix karo, aur historical comparison maintain karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview examples

items.question: LLM kya hai?
items.answer: Large Language Model large text/data corpora se language patterns learn karta hai aur token-by-token generation ya language understanding tasks perform karta hai.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Tokenization kya hai?
items.answer: Text ko tokens me break karna. Model raw text ke bajay token IDs process karta hai.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Embedding kya hai?
items.answer: Token/text ko dense numeric vector me map karna, jisse semantic relationships mathematically represent kiye ja sakte hain.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Transformer ki key strength kya hai?
items.answer: Self-attention ki wajah se long-range relationships ko parallel processing ke saath model karna easy hota hai.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Self-attention ka intuition?
items.answer: Current token ke liye sequence ke relevant tokens ko importance weights dekar context vector banana.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Q, K, V kya hain?
items.answer: Query poochta hai mujhe kya relevant chahiye, Key batata hai token kis type ka context deta hai, Value actual information carry karta hai.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Positional information kyun chahiye?
items.answer: Attention itself token order ko inherently encode nahi karta, isliye sequence position information add karni hoti hai.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Causal language modeling kya hai?
items.answer: Previous tokens dekhkar next token predict karna.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Masked language modeling kya hai?
items.answer: Sequence me kuch tokens hide karke model ko context se unhe predict karwana.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Temperature ka role?
items.answer: Sampling distribution ki sharpness change karta hai; lower usually more deterministic, higher more diverse.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Top-k vs top-p?
items.answer: Top-k fixed number of likely tokens rakhta hai; top-p cumulative probability threshold ke basis par variable candidate set banata hai.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Context window kya hai?
items.answer: Ek model request ke dauran available token budget jisme input/context/output constraints operate karte hain.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Hallucination kya hai?
items.answer: Model ka plausible-looking lekin unsupported/incorrect information generate karna.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: LLM hallucinate kyun karta hai?
items.answer: Objective language continuation hai; truth verification guaranteed mechanism nahi hota jab external grounding absent ho.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Fine-tuning kab use karoge?
items.answer: Behavior/style/task adaptation ke liye jab prompt + retrieval se repeatable quality achieve na ho aur labeled training data available ho.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: LoRA kya hai?
items.answer: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning approach jisme low-rank trainable updates use hote hain instead of all model parameters.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Quantization kya hai?
items.answer: Weights/activations ko lower precision representation me convert karke memory aur compute reduce karna.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Distillation kya hai?
items.answer: Large teacher model ke behavior ko smaller student model me transfer karna.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: Model selection kaise karoge?
items.answer: Quality, latency, context, tool support, cost, privacy, reliability aur workload fit ke against benchmark karunga.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.question: LLM evaluation kyun hard hai?
items.answer: Open-ended outputs me multiple correct answers ho sakte hain aur surface fluency correctness guarantee nahi karti.
items.heading: LLM & Transformers

items.answer: Retriever external knowledge fetch karta hai aur LLM retrieved context ke basis par answer generate karta hai.

items.answer: Ingest -> chunk -> embed -> index; query -> retrieve -> context -> generate.

items.answer: Embeddings ko efficiently store/search karne wala system.

items.question: Semantic search kya hai?
items.answer: Meaning/similarity ke basis par relevant content find karna, exact keyword match se beyond.

items.question: Chunking ka impact?
items.answer: Bad chunking retrieval quality reduce kar sakti hai; structure-aware chunking often better context boundaries preserve karti hai.

items.question: Hybrid search kya hai?
items.answer: Keyword + semantic retrieval combine karna.

items.question: RAG hallucination solve karta hai?

items.answer: Streaming, caching, smaller model route, parallel tools, retrieval optimization aur fewer tokens.

items.question: Cost reduce kaise?
items.answer: Model routing, caching, context pruning, batching, quotas aur per-workflow budgets.

items.answer: Stateless API replicas, managed durable stores, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, health checks.

items.question: Async workload kab?
items.answer: Long-running research, batch analysis, large document processing ya background agent tasks.

items.question: Queue kyun?
items.answer: Spike absorb, retries, decouple producers/consumers aur backpressure ke liye.

items.question: Cache kya karoge?
items.answer: Stable retrieval results, embeddings, metadata, repeated prompts where semantics remain valid.

items.answer: Task complexity, latency budget, privacy, modality, context requirement, expected quality aur cost ko routing signals banaunga. Route decision deterministic rules + benchmark data se tune karunga.

items.question: RAG me query rewriting kya hai?
items.answer: User query ko retrieval-friendly form me transform karna, jaise missing keywords add karna ya ambiguous references clarify karna. Rewrite ko answer claim nahi samajhna chahiye.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: HyDE style retrieval ka idea kya hai?
items.answer: Model se hypothetical relevant passage banwa kar uska embedding retrieve ke liye use karna. Isse semantic recall improve ho sakta hai, lekin hallucinated query drift ko evaluate karna zaroori hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Parent-child retrieval kya solve karta hai?
items.answer: Small child chunks precision improve karte hain aur parent document broader context provide karta hai. Retrieval unit aur generation context ko alag rakhne ka pattern hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: RAG me ACL kaise preserve karoge?
items.answer: Ingestion par permission metadata attach karo, retrieval me mandatory authorization filters lagao, aur tool/data access layer par second enforcement rakho.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: RAG freshness SLA kya hota hai?
items.answer: Define karo ki source update ke kitne time andar index reflect karega. Freshness timestamp monitor karo aur stale results par fallback ya warning design karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Retriever recall high but answer quality low kyun?
items.answer: Relevant document retrieved ho sakta hai lekin context packing, ordering, contradictory sources, model instruction ya evidence selection fail ho sakte hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Context packing kya hai?
items.answer: Retrieved evidence ko order, deduplicate, compress aur source metadata ke saath model context me arrange karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Lost-in-the-middle problem ko kaise reduce karoge?
items.answer: Relevant evidence ko carefully position karo, context size limit karo, summarize/rerank karo aur critical evidence ko final prompt structure me high-salience placement do.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: RAG me duplicate chunks problem?
items.answer: Same semantic content ko near-duplicate removal, MMR/diversity selection aur document-level dedupe se reduce karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Tool latency aggregation kaise samjho?
items.answer: Sequential calls latency add karte hain; independent calls parallel ho sakte hain. Trace spans se critical path identify karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Tool timeout ka default behavior?
items.answer: Bounded timeout, cancellation, retry only for safe/idempotent operations, aur user-facing degraded response define karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Retry storm kya hai?
items.answer: Multiple layers ek hi failure ko retry karein to traffic multiply ho sakta hai. Central retry policy, jitter, budgets aur circuit breakers use karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Idempotency key ka practical example?
items.answer: Payment/refund/order-write request me client-generated key store karo; same key repeat hone par same prior result return karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Saga pattern AI workflows me kab?
items.answer: Multi-step distributed side effects me transaction impossible ho to compensating actions ke saath saga-style workflow use kar sakte ho.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Human approval ko model se kyun nahi karwana?
items.answer: Approval ka purpose independent control boundary banana hai; same model ko apne action ko approve karne dena separation of duties weak karta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent budget kya hai?
items.answer: Per-run limits such as max steps, tool calls, tokens, wall-clock time and spend. Budget exceed par controlled stop/fallback.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent termination conditions?
items.answer: Goal satisfied, verifier pass, explicit user stop, max budget, deadline, repeated-state/cycle detection ya safety policy block.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Verifier agent ka role?
items.answer: Generated result ya action ko independent criteria ke against check karna. Verifier ko same failure mode reproduce karne se bachane ke liye diverse checks useful hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Critic vs verifier difference?
items.answer: Critic suggestions/quality feedback deta hai; verifier binary/structured validity decision de sakta hai. Real system me dono combine ho sakte hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent memory me privacy issue?
items.answer: Har memory item ko user consent, retention, purpose, access scope aur delete/update semantics ke through govern karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Memory poisoning kya hai?
items.answer: Malicious ya incorrect stored memory future decisions influence kare. Write validation, provenance, confidence and user-visible memory controls useful hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Multi-agent communication protocol kya define kare?
items.answer: Message schema, sender identity, allowed recipients, payload limits, correlation ID, timeout, retry policy and termination semantics.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Supervisor agent bottleneck kaise reduce?
items.answer: Parallel specialization, static routing for obvious cases, bounded delegation and batching. Supervisor ko every micro- step decide na karne do.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent observability me trace hierarchy?
items.answer: Request trace ke andar model, retrieval, tool, policy, verifier aur external API spans. Har span me latency, status aur safe metadata.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Quality regression after model upgrade?
items.answer: Golden eval suite rerun, segmented slices compare, critical business flows gate karo aur canary deployment use karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Prompt regression after tool schema change?
items.answer: Tool-call eval cases aur contract tests rerun karo; invalid-argument rate, tool selection accuracy and downstream outcomes compare karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Eval set leakage kya hai?
items.answer: Agar test cases prompt/training/optimization loop me repeatedly expose ho jayein to test score unrealistic ho sakta hai. Holdout sets maintain karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Synthetic eval data ka risk?
items.answer: Synthetic data coverage fast badhata hai, lekin distribution bias ya unrealistic cases aa sakte hain. Human-labeled holdout mix karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: LLM-as-a-judge ka limitation?
items.answer: Judge bhi model bias/error carry kar sakta hai. Rubric, calibration, pairwise checks and human sampling se validate karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Data scientist ke liye calibration kyun?
items.answer: Predicted probabilities ko observed frequencies ke saath align karne ke liye. Risk thresholds aur decision policies me calibration useful hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Precision-recall threshold kaise choose?
items.answer: Business false-positive vs false-negative cost ko define karke validation set par threshold tune karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Drift alert kaise avoid false positives?
items.answer: Seasonality, expected promotions aur known distribution shifts model karo; baseline window aur alert hysteresis use karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Feature store ka core idea?
items.answer: Reusable, governed features ko consistent training aur online inference use cases ke liye manage karna. Offline/online consistency important hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Point-in-time correctness kya hai?
items.answer: Historical training row ke timestamp par jo information available thi sirf wahi join honi chahiye; future leakage avoid karta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Backfill kaise safe karoge?
items.answer: Idempotent transforms, versioned inputs, partition-scoped reruns, data quality checks and downstream impact review.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Late-arriving dimension kya problem hai?
items.answer: Fact event dimension record se pehle aa sakta hai; pipeline ko surrogate/default key ya delayed enrichment strategy chahiye.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Slowly changing dimension Type 2?
items.answer: Har historical change ka new row/version maintain karke valid_from/valid_to jaise timestamps se history preserve karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Partition pruning kya hai?
items.answer: Query filters se irrelevant partitions/files skip karna, scan cost reduce karta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Small files problem kya hai?
items.answer: Bahut chhoti files metadata overhead aur read inefficiency create karti hain. Compaction/optimize strategy use hoti hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Data skew ka fix?
items.answer: Salting, skew-aware joins, repartitioning, broadcast where appropriate, and key redesign depending on workload.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: CDC delete handling?
items.answer: Delete events preserve karo ya tombstone semantics use karo; sink table ko delete/soft-delete policy ke saath synchronize karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Schema registry kyun?
items.answer: Event schemas ko version aur compatibility rules ke saath manage karne ke liye.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Backward compatible schema change?
items.answer: Naya producer/consumer old clients ko break na kare. Optional fields and compatible type evolution preferred.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Data observability kya track kare?
items.answer: Freshness, volume, distribution, schema, nulls, duplicates, lineage and downstream incidents.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Semantic layer kyun?
items.answer: Business metrics ko consistent definitions aur reusable dimensions ke saath expose karne ke liye, so BI and AI agree on meaning.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Metric contract kya hai?
items.answer: Metric name, formula, grain, filters, owner, update cadence and source-of-truth explicitly define karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Funnel drop-off kaise diagnose?
items.answer: Step-wise conversion, segment breakdown, cohort comparison and event instrumentation audit. Aggregate rate se cause assume mat karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Cohort analysis kya?
items.answer: Users ko common start event/time ke basis par group karke retention/revenue behavior over time compare karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: RFM analysis kya?
items.answer: Recency, frequency, monetary value ke basis par customers segment karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: A/B test interference kya hai?
items.answer: One user ka treatment doosre users ke outcome ko affect kare. Network effects/social features me independent-unit assumption fail ho sakti hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Experiment guardrail metric?
items.answer: Primary goal ke saath safety/business health metric, jaise churn, latency, refunds or support tickets, jisse harmful trade-off detect ho.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Causal inference vs prediction?
items.answer: Prediction future outcome estimate karta hai; causal inference treatment/intervention effect estimate karta hai. Objective aur assumptions different hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Feature importance vs causality?
items.answer: Important predictive feature hona causal effect prove nahi karta. Correlated proxy bhi high importance de sakta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Data engineer aur AI engineer handoff?
items.answer: Data engineer reliable contracts, quality, lineage and serving interfaces deta hai; AI engineer retrieval/model/tool logic ko consume karke application behavior build karta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Production schema migration ka safe approach?
items.answer: Versioned migration, backward compatibility window, dual-read/write where needed, validation and rollback plan.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Canary AI deployment me kya compare?
items.answer: Error rate, task success, safety violations, latency, cost, tool-call failures and business KPIs by traffic slice.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Disaster recovery for AI system?
items.answer: Versioned artifacts, durable data, backups, restore drills, fallback provider/model, RPO/RTO definitions and tested runbooks.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: RPO vs RTO?
items.answer: RPO = kitna data loss acceptable; RTO = service ko kitni der me restore karna target hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Blue-green vs canary?
items.answer: Blue-green full environment switch pattern; canary gradual traffic exposure pattern. Risk and rollback workflow differ.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Load shedding kya hai?
items.answer: Overload me low-priority work reject/defer karke critical traffic preserve karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Backpressure kya hai?
items.answer: Fast producer ko slow consumer ke rate ke according control karna; queues, flow control and admission limits use hote hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Queue ordering guarantee kaise choose?
items.answer: Business requirement ke hisaab se global ordering, partition/key ordering or no ordering. Strong ordering throughput reduce kar sakta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Exactly-once ko interview me kaise explain?
items.answer: End-to-end property hai, sirf broker feature nahi. Usually idempotent processing, transactional writes and replay- safe design se practical exactly-once effects achieve karte hain.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: SQL window function kab?
items.answer: Running totals, ranking, lag/lead, retention calculations aur row-level analytics ke liye.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: AI analytics copilot me SQL safety?
items.answer: Read-only role, allowlisted schemas, query parser/validator, row/scan limits, timeout and result-size caps.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Text-to-SQL hallucination ka control?
items.answer: Semantic schema context + constrained generation + SQL parser + allowlist + dry-run/EXPLAIN + result validation.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agentic Text-to-SQL ka extra risk?
items.answer: Agent query generate, execute aur iterate kar sakta hai; execution permissions aur budget ko tightly gate karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Why not expose raw DB credentials to agent?
items.answer: Credentials broad privilege aur data exfiltration risk create karte hain. Scoped service identity/tool gateway safer boundary hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Tool gateway kya hai?
items.answer: Central policy-enforcing layer jo tool definitions, auth, rate limits, logging, schema validation aur routing manage karti hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Policy engine ka role?
items.answer: Allowed actions ko user, tenant, environment, tool and risk level ke basis par decide karna.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Auditability ka minimum?
items.answer: Who, what, when, which policy, which tool, outcome and approval - safe metadata ke saath traceable record.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Reproducibility kya?
items.answer: Same model/prompt/tool/data/config versions ke saath result behavior ko rerun aur compare kar pana.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Artifact registry me kya store?
items.answer: Model/version, prompt/config, evaluation results, dependency metadata, deployment status and rollback target.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Embedding index reproducibility?
items.answer: Embedding model/version, chunker config, preprocessing, metadata schema and index parameters version karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent benchmark kaise banega?
items.answer: Representative task set + expected outcomes + allowed tools + success criteria + adversarial cases + cost/latency budget.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Tool selection accuracy kaise measure?
items.answer: Expected tool vs selected tool compare karo, wrong-tool rate aur downstream success rate separately track karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent handoff loop kaise detect?
items.answer: Correlation IDs and state history se repeated agent transitions detect karo; max handoffs and cycle rules lagao.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: MCP tool catalog cache kyun?
items.answer: Tool discovery response cache karne se repeated listing overhead reduce ho sakta hai; current MCP 2026 spec list responses ko cache hints ke saath support karta hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: MCP stateless architecture ka benefit?
items.answer: Ordinary HTTP load balancing aur horizontal scaling easier ho sakta hai because protocol session affinity requirement remove hui.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: MCP skill content ko trusted instructions maana chahiye?
items.answer: Nahi. Current Skills extension explicitly prompt-injection risk ke perspective se served skill content ko untrusted input treat karti hai.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: MCP server trust model?
items.answer: Connected server ko automatically trusted business authority mat samjho; origin, authorization, capability scope and user approvals define karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Long-running agent ko kaise resume?
items.answer: Checkpointed state + deterministic resume boundary + idempotent side effects + run identity use karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Background agent UX kya hona chahiye?
items.answer: Immediate acknowledgement + job ID/status + progress events + cancel/retry + final result notification.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: AI system ka error budget?
items.answer: Reliability budget define karo; frequent errors/retries/cost spikes par feature rollout slow ya rollback kar sakte ho.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Agent cost attribution kaise?
items.answer: Trace level par model tokens, tool/API cost, retrieval calls and compute time aggregate karke tenant/project attribution karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Evaluation me segmentation kyun?
items.answer: Average score hidden failures hide kar sakta hai. Language, customer tier, task type, document type and adversarial slice by slice inspect karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Human review sampling kaise?
items.answer: Random + risk-based sampling combine karo. High-impact/low-confidence outputs ko higher review probability do.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: What is a safe fallback?
items.answer: Aisa deterministic/degraded response jo wrong action na le aur user ko next safe step de. Fallback ko evaluate aur monitor karo.
items.heading: Advanced Cross-Role Questions

items.question: Aapne LangChain kyun use kiya?
items.answer: Tool/model integration aur agent composition fast karne ke liye. Jahan complex stateful orchestration required hai wahan LangGraph add kiya.
items.heading: Project defense questions

items.question: RAG kyun, fine-tuning kyun nahi?
items.answer: Knowledge frequently change hoti hai to retrieval better fit hai; fine-tuning behavior adaptation ke liye consider kiya.
items.heading: Project defense questions

items.question: Aapka agent galat tool call kare to?
items.answer: Schema validation, authorization, retry/repair, verifier aur approval gate use karta hoon.
items.heading: Project defense questions

items.question: Latency high aaye to?
items.answer: Trace se bottleneck identify karunga; retrieval/model/tool calls ko parallelize/cache/route karunga.
items.heading: Project defense questions

items.question: Production me failover?
items.answer: Timeouts, retries, fallback model/provider, degraded response and queue-based recovery design karunga.
items.heading: Project defense questions

items.question: Aap quality kaise measure karte ho?
items.answer: Golden eval set, task correctness, groundedness, tool correctness, safety, latency aur cost metrics use karta hoon.
items.heading: Project defense questions

items.question: SQL me LEFT JOIN ke baad row count achanak kyun badh sakta hai?
items.answer: Right table me one-to-many match ho sakta hai. Grain check karo aur join key uniqueness validate karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: WHERE aur HAVING me difference?
items.answer: WHERE rows ko grouping se pehle filter karta hai; HAVING aggregate/group result ko filter karta hai.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: ROW_NUMBER aur RANK me difference?
items.answer: ROW_NUMBER unique sequence deta hai; RANK ties par same rank de sakta hai aur gaps aa sakte hain.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Cohort analysis kya solve karta hai?
items.answer: Same start event/time wale users ko group karke retention, revenue ya engagement ko time ke saath compare karta hai.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Funnel analysis me sabse common mistake kya hai?
items.answer: Different events ko inconsistent user/session grain par compare karna. Har stage ka definition aur denominator clear rakho.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Dashboard me metric conflict kaise solve karoge?
items.answer: Single semantic definition, owner, source-of-truth, refresh rule aur metric contract publish karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Data me outlier dekh kar remove kar doge?
items.answer: Automatically nahi. Pehle identify karo ki outlier error hai, rare valid event hai ya segment behavior.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: A/B test dashboard me kya dikhaoge?
items.answer: Primary metric, confidence interval, guardrails, sample size, segment breakdown aur experiment status.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: SQL query slow hai to pehla step kya?
items.answer: Query plan dekho, scan volume/join order/index/partition pruning aur unnecessary columns check karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: AI analytics copilot ko raw DB access doge?
items.answer: Nahi. Read-only scoped identity, allowlisted schemas, parser/validator, row/scan limits aur timeout use karunga.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Prediction aur causal inference me difference?
items.answer: Prediction future outcome ko accurately estimate karta hai; causal inference intervention ka effect estimate karta hai. Assumptions aur design dono different hote hain.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Cross-validation kab use nahi karna chahiye?
items.answer: Time series ya grouped/related observations me random folds leakage create kar sakte hain; structure-aware split chahiye.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: PR-AUC imbalanced data me useful kyun?
items.answer: Rare positive class par precision-recall trade-off ko focus karta hai; accuracy aur ROC-AUC ke saath context me interpret karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Calibration kya hai?
items.answer: Predicted probabilities aur actual event frequencies ke alignment ko measure karna.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Feature importance causality prove karta hai?
items.answer: Nahi. Feature predictive signal ho sakta hai ya proxy/confounder ho sakta hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: A/B test me sample ratio mismatch kya signal ho sakta hai?
items.answer: Randomization ya traffic assignment problem ka signal ho sakta hai; experiment instrumentation audit karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: p-value < 0.05 ka matlab kya?
items.answer: Null hypothesis true hone ki probability simply 5% nahi hoti. It means H0 ke under observed ya more-extreme evidence ka tail probability threshold se chhota hai, given test setup.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Model score high hai par production weak kyun?
items.answer: Distribution shift, leakage, threshold mismatch, poor calibration, label delay, latency or business behavior change ho sakta hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Class imbalance ka basic fix?
items.answer: Metric choice, thresholding, class weights/resampling aur business cost matrix consider karo; blind oversampling nahi.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Time series forecast me random shuffle problem?
items.answer: Future observations train me aa sakte hain, jisse validation falsely optimistic ho jata hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A

items.question: Data SLA aur SLO me difference kya?
items.answer: SLA external commitment ho sakta hai; SLO internal reliability target. Example: data 99% days me 7 AM se pehle fresh ho.
items.heading: SQL data-quality gate

items.question: Lineage kyun important hai?
items.answer: Column/table change se kaunse downstream dashboards, models ya AI indexes impact honge, ye quickly trace karne ke liye.
items.heading: SQL data-quality gate

items.question: Vector index ko data pipeline ka part kyun samjhenge?
items.answer: RAG me corpus change hone par chunks, embeddings, metadata aur index refresh coordinated hona chahiye; otherwise stale retrieval ho sakta hai.
items.heading: SQL data-quality gate

items.question: Data reconciliation ka pattern?
items.answer: Source vs target row counts, sums, key sets aur sampled records compare karo, especially migration/backfill ke baad.
items.heading: SQL data-quality gate

items.question: Idempotent pipeline kya hai?
items.answer: Same input ko retry karne par final business state duplicate nahi banta. Keys, merge/upsert aur deterministic transformations help karte hain.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: CDC me delete kaise handle karoge?
items.answer: Tombstone/delete event capture karo aur downstream sink me hard-delete ya soft-delete policy apply karo.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Kafka partition ka main purpose?
items.answer: Parallelism aur per-partition ordering provide karna. Global ordering expensive aur usually unnecessary hoti hai.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Consumer group kya karta hai?
items.answer: Same topic ko multiple consumers me partitions distribute karta hai so processing parallel ho sake.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Watermark kyun?
items.answer: Event-time streaming me late data ke against state growth ko bound karne aur completeness trade-off manage karne ke liye.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Exactly-once ko kaise explain karoge?
items.answer: End-to-end property samjho. Broker alone enough nahi; idempotent processing, transactional writes aur replay-safe design zaroori hai.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Data skew ka impact?
items.answer: Kuch partitions huge ho kar straggler tasks create karte hain. Key redesign, salting, repartitioning ya selective broadcast help kar sakte hain.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Small-files problem kya?
items.answer: Too many tiny objects/files metadata aur scan overhead badhate hain; compaction/optimized write strategy help karti hai.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Backfill safe kaise?
items.answer: Partition-scoped rerun, versioned inputs, idempotent transforms, isolated outputs aur downstream compatibility checks.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: SCD Type 2 kya?
items.answer: Dimension ke historical versions ko separate rows me valid_from/valid_to ya equivalent validity columns se track karna.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Lakehouse kya solve karta hai?
items.answer: Object-storage scale/flexibility ke saath transactional tables, schema controls, time travel aur analytical serving patterns combine karta hai.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: dbt incremental model kyun?
items.answer: Large table ko har run full recompute karne ke bajay new/changed slice process karke runtime/cost reduce karna.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Data contract kya?
items.answer: Schema + semantics + ownership + freshness/SLA + compatibility/change policy ka explicit agreement.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Feature leakage kya?
items.answer: Training feature me future information aa jana. Point-in-time correctness se avoid karna chahiye.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Data observability kya dekhta hai?
items.answer: Freshness, volume, schema, distributions, nulls, duplicates, lineage aur downstream incident signals.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A

items.question: Agent aur chatbot me main difference?
items.answer: Chatbot mostly conversation handle karta hai. Agent goal pursue karte hue tools, state aur multi-step actions use kar sakta hai.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Agent ko autonomous kab banana chahiye?
items.answer: Jab task multi-step ho, tool decisions dynamic hon aur safe termination/evaluation possible ho. Simple deterministic work me unnecessary autonomy avoid karo.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Planner aur executor separate kyun?
items.answer: Planning ko execution se isolate karke traceability, retries aur specialized policies better manage ki ja sakti hain.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Agent loop infinite kyun hota hai?
items.answer: No-progress detection, max steps, ambiguous goals, tool failures ya repeated state ki wajah se. Hard budgets lagao.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Memory blindly store karna sahi hai?
items.answer: Nahi. Sensitive data, stale facts aur wrong preferences future behavior distort kar sakte hain. Retention/write policy chahiye.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Multi-agent kab avoid karoge?
items.answer: Jab single agent/workflow same outcome simpler, cheaper aur more testable way se de raha ho.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Deep agent aur custom graph me trade-off?
items.answer: Deep agent prebuilt capabilities fast deta hai; custom graph me exact state transitions aur control zyada milta hai.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Agentic RAG vs fixed RAG?
items.answer: Fixed RAG predetermined retrieval path use karta hai. Agentic RAG query strategy dynamically adapt kar sakta hai.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: AVO se AI engineer kya seekh sakta hai?
items.answer: Agent ko candidate generator se iterative variation/evaluation loop tak le ja sakte ho, but objective function, correctness gates and rollback critical hain.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Production RAG me ACL kaise enforce karoge?
items.answer: Retrieval metadata me tenant/user permissions propagate karunga aur authorization ko retrieval se pehle/baad ke layers me enforce karunga; filtered evidence ke bina answer nahi dena.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Tool gateway kyun?
items.answer: Central layer me auth, schema validation, rate limit, logging aur routing ko standardize kar sakte hain.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Fallback model ka risk?
items.answer: Smaller model quality lower ho sakti hai; fallback ko same eval suite aur policy checks se validate karna chahiye.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Agent latency ka bottleneck kaise find?
items.answer: Trace spans se retrieval, model, tool aur verifier time compare karunga; parallelization/cache/routing se optimize karunga.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Structured output fail ho to?
items.answer: Schema validation -> constrained retry/repair -> safe fallback; invalid payload ko side-effecting tool tak nahi bhejna.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: LLM provider switch ke liye kya design?
items.answer: Model adapter/standard interface, capability matrix, prompt compatibility tests aur provider-specific fallbacks.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Human approval kis action par?
items.answer: Irreversible, high-impact, high-cost ya permission-sensitive actions par risk-based approval.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Agent observability me kya log?
items.answer: Request ID, model/version, prompt version, retrieval IDs, tool names/latency, state transitions, policy decisions, outcome and cost-safe metadata.
items.heading: Agentic AI interview Q&A

items.question: Offline metric improve par business metric same kyun?
items.answer: Metric misaligned, threshold wrong, selection bias, latency, intervention effect ya user behavior change ho sakta hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Model calibration kab important?
items.answer: Risk scores, ranking by probability, triage aur decision thresholds jahan probability ka meaning operational action se linked ho.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Experiment me novelty effect kya?
items.answer: Users nayi feature se temporarily different behave kar sakte hain; experiment duration aur cohort stabilization consider karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Causal claim ke liye best evidence?
items.answer: Randomized experiment ideal case ho sakta hai; observational settings me identification assumptions explicit honi chahiye.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Imbalanced classification me threshold kaise choose?
items.answer: Business cost, precision-recall tradeoff, calibration aur review capacity ko together consider karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Time-series cross validation?
items.answer: Rolling/expanding windows ya forward-chaining use karo so future information leak na ho.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Feature store kyu?
items.answer: Training aur online serving ke beech consistent, point-in-time-correct feature access manage karne me help karta hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist - Interview Set

items.question: Metric definition me grain kya?
items.answer: Ek row kis business entity/time unit ko represent karti hai; grain wrong hua to aggregates double-count ho sakte hain.
items.heading: Data Analyst - Interview Set

items.question: Cohort retention ka denominator?
items.answer: Har cohort ke baseline population ko clearly define karke later periods me active users divided by that cohort baseline.
items.heading: Data Analyst - Interview Set

items.question: Dashboard alert kab create karoge?
items.answer: Jab deviation meaningful ho, action clear ho aur noise manageable ho.
items.heading: Data Analyst - Interview Set

items.question: SQL dedup ka common pattern?
items.answer: ROW_NUMBER over business key ordered by event/update timestamp, then rn = 1.
items.heading: Data Analyst - Interview Set

items.question: Analyst AI copilot ko reliable kaise?
items.answer: Semantic schema, read-only access, SQL validation, query limits, result checks and cited metric definitions.
items.heading: Data Analyst - Interview Set

items.question: Correlation high hai to action loge?
items.answer: Correlation hypothesis generate karta hai; business action se pehle confounders aur causal evidence check karunga.
items.heading: Data Analyst - Interview Set

items.question: Backfill aur replay me difference?
items.answer: Backfill historical time range ko recompute karta hai; replay raw/event log se processing dobara chalata hai. Dono ke liye idempotency important hai.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: At-least-once consumer me duplicates kaise?
items.answer: Message retry se duplicate delivery ho sakti hai; idempotent sink/dedup key use karo.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: Watermark too aggressive ho to?
items.answer: Late valid events drop ho sakte hain. Delay threshold ko observed lateness aur business tolerance ke basis par tune karo.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: Partition key kaise choose?
items.answer: Even distribution + query locality + ordering requirement + hot-key risk ko together dekho.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: Schema breaking change ka safe plan?
items.answer: Versioned contract, compatibility window, dual-read/write where needed, validation and rollback.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: Data quality gate ka blast radius kaise control?
items.answer: Critical vs advisory checks separate, quarantine bad partitions, notify owners, and prevent only unsafe downstream publishes.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: Lakehouse maintenance kyun?
items.answer: Snapshots/files/metadata accumulate ho sakte hain; retention and compaction health ko maintain rakhte hain.
items.heading: Data Engineer - Interview Set

items.question: Grain kya hota hai?
items.answer: Ek row kis business event/entity/time level ko represent karti hai. Grain galat hua to joins ke baad double counting ho sakti hai.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: LEFT JOIN se rows double kyun hoti hain?
items.answer: Agar right table me join key par multiple matches hain to one-to-many multiplication hoti hai. Pehle grain aur key uniqueness verify karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Window function kab use karoge?
items.answer: Row context preserve rakhte hue ranking, running totals, lag/lead aur rolling metrics ke liye.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: CTE kyun useful hai?
items.answer: Complex query ko logical stages me todne, readability badhane aur intermediate logic validate karne ke liye.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Cohort analysis ka purpose?
items.answer: Same starting event/date wale users ko group karke time ke saath retention/behavior compare karna.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Retention numerator/denominator kaise define?
items.answer: Numerator active users in a later period; denominator original cohort population. Dono definitions explicit honi chahiye.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Dashboard me 100 metrics rakhna sahi hai?
items.answer: Usually nahi. Role-specific decision metrics, supporting diagnostics aur clear ownership better hote hain.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: A/B test me primary metric kyun define karte?
items.answer: Taaki success criteria experiment ke baad opportunistically change na ho. Guardrail metrics bhi predefine karo.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Correlation high hai to causation?
items.answer: Nahi. Confounders ya reverse causality possible hai. Causal claim ke liye stronger design/evidence chahiye.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Data storytelling ka structure?
items.answer: Context -> key finding -> evidence -> business impact -> action -> limitation/next step.
items.heading: Data Analyst interview Q&A

items.question: Baseline model kyun?
items.answer: Baseline tumhe reference deta hai. Complex model tabhi useful hai jab measurable improvement aaye aur cost/latency acceptable rahe.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Cross-validation aur time-series split me difference?
items.answer: Random CV iid-like data me useful ho sakta hai; temporal data me future leakage avoid karne ke liye forward/rolling split better hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Feature importance ko causal effect samajhna sahi hai?
items.answer: Nahi. Feature importance predictive contribution dikha sakta hai, causal effect nahi.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Model score improve but production worsen kyun?
items.answer: Distribution shift, latency, missing features, threshold mismatch, feedback loop ya metric mismatch ho sakta hai.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Drift ke types?
items.answer: Input/data distribution shift, target/relationship shift aur model performance degradation ko alag monitor karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Retraining kab?
items.answer: Fixed schedule ke saath blindly nahi. Drift, performance degradation, data freshness aur business change ke signals ke basis par policy define karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Causal inference ka basic mindset?
items.answer: Counterfactual socho: intervention na hota to outcome kya hota? Design aur assumptions explicit rakho.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Error analysis ka best output?
items.answer: Errors ko meaningful slices me group karke top failure modes, examples aur next engineering/model changes identify karo.
items.heading: Data Scientist interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Idempotent pipeline?
items.answer: Same input ko retry karne par same intended final state mile aur duplicate side effects na bane.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: CDC me delete kaise?
items.answer: Delete event/tombstone capture karke downstream policy ke hisaab se soft ya hard delete apply karo.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Small files problem?
items.answer: Too many tiny files metadata/scan overhead badhate hain; compaction aur write sizing strategy help karti hai.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Data lineage kyun?
items.answer: Upstream source se downstream dashboard/model tak impact analysis, debugging aur governance ke liye.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Schema evolution ka safe plan?
items.answer: Backward-compatible change, versioned contract, migration window, validation aur rollback.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Exactly-once ko kaise discuss?
items.answer: Transport-level claim se zyada end-to-end semantics dekho: replay-safe processing, transactional sink ya idempotent writes aur checkpointing.
items.heading: Data Engineer interview Q&A - advanced

items.question: Consumer lag kya?
items.answer: Latest available offset aur consumer progress ke beech ka gap; sustained lag capacity/processing issue signal ho sakta hai.
items.heading: Big Data interview Q&A

items.question: Hot partition kya?
items.answer: Uneven key distribution se ek partition disproportionate load le leta hai.
items.heading: Big Data interview Q&A

items.question: Watermark ka trade-off?
items.answer: Late data tolerance badhao to state zyada retain ho sakta hai; aggressive watermark memory bachata hai but valid late events drop kar sakta hai.
items.heading: Big Data interview Q&A

items.question: Backpressure kya?
items.answer: Downstream slow hone par upstream processing ko control karna taaki unbounded queue/memory growth na ho.
items.heading: Big Data interview Q&A

items.question: Replayable pipeline kyun?
items.answer: Historical bug fix, recovery aur backfill ke liye raw event log se deterministic recomputation useful hoti hai.
items.heading: Big Data interview Q&A

items.question: Dead-letter queue/topic ka use?
items.answer: Poison messages ko isolate karna, main stream ko block na hone dena aur later repair/replay allow karna.
items.heading: Big Data interview Q&A

items.question: Agent ko workflow se kab replace karoge?
items.answer: Jab steps deterministic hon aur decision branching fixed ho. Har problem me agent add karna complexity badha sakta hai.
items.heading: Agentic AI practice Q&A

items.question: Agentic system me deterministic layer kyun?
items.answer: Auth, billing rules, schema validation, risk checks aur irreversible actions ko deterministic boundary dena reliability improve karta hai.
items.heading: Agentic AI practice Q&A

items.question: Tool description kitni important?
items.answer: Bahut important. Agent tool selection ke liye description/schema par depend karta hai; ambiguous descriptions wrong tool calls kara sakti hain.
items.heading: Agentic AI practice Q&A

items.question: Agent ko production me unrestricted access dena?
items.answer: Avoid. Least privilege, scoped credentials, per-tool permissions aur approval gates use karo.
items.heading: Agentic AI practice Q&A

items.question: Agent eval me sirf final answer enough?
items.answer: Nahi. Tool selection, arguments, retrieval, policy compliance, latency, cost aur final outcome bhi evaluate karo.
items.heading: Agentic AI practice Q&A

items.question: LangGraph kyun?
items.answer: Jab stateful, branching, retry, persistence, human approval aur long-running workflow ko explicit control chahiye.
items.heading: LangGraph/MCP interview Q&A

items.question: Graph node me kya hona chahiye?
items.answer: Single responsibility step: model call, retrieval, tool execution, validation ya routing. Shared state typed aur minimal rakho.
items.heading: LangGraph/MCP interview Q&A

items.question: MCP aur normal REST API me difference?
items.answer: REST API custom app-to-app integration hai; MCP AI applications ko tools/resources/prompts discoverable standard ke through expose karne ke liye protocol layer deta hai.
items.heading: LangGraph/MCP interview Q&A

items.question: MCP tool ko trusted maana?
items.answer: Nahi. Tool metadata aur results ko security boundary ke through validate karo; permissions explicit rakho.
items.heading: LangGraph/MCP interview Q&A

items.question: Multi-agent se quality automatically improve?
items.answer: Nahi. More agents cost/latency aur coordination errors bhi badha sakte hain; benchmark ke basis par justify karo.
